sourced_fact: Paired selection tags old/new parents by coordinate and sum type, feeds2q coordinates to one joint selector, and obtains one common selected set. JointColorAdapter adds one fine-color coordinate with trivial parent. One weighted pigeonhole chooses the entire color vector before simultaneous degree regularization.
mechanism: A heavy joint color class is selected once. Restricting weights to zero outside this class lets positive selected weights force containment in that same class. The finite regularizer first selects a positive dyadic weight band, then one joint dyadic DEGREE VECTOR across all m coordinates, then applies one T-core pruning. This is not repeated arbitrary restriction by scale.
loss_accounting: For q original coordinates, paired adapter pays fineColorCount*parentColorCount^(2q), weight loss8*L^(2q+2) and degree factor16*(2q+1)*L^(2q+1), L=Nat.log2(2|I|)+1. Extra constant-color coordinates overcount colors harmlessly; these factors match the existing caller envelope. No loss-free claim or optimal constants asserted.
core_argument: Finite nonzero weights have total finite. Weight band c<=w<=2c has0<c<infinity, so cancellation by c is guarded. One degree-vector class S0 pays L^m. Vertex counting bounds I-double-prime.card by2*L^m*S0.card. Thresholds floor(2^b_k/(4mL^m)) feed T-core existence; removed count is at most half S0. Weight comparability then pays factor4, giving total retention8*L^(m+1). Degree uniformity explicitly separates zero threshold from positive threshold, avoiding division by zero.
degenerate_cases: Total zero returns empty selection. m=0 handled before positive-coordinate arguments. An infinite individual weight selects a singleton and weightLevel=infinity. Only afterward is the all-finite branch entered, and the cancellation of c uses c!=0 and c!=infinity. Upper adapters demand positive total to prove nonempty output; their added coordinate guarantees positive coordinate count for band packaging.
